# Issue:
In the latest Beta the Social Tab was moved away from your Profile and right next to Avatars. I don't think this was the right thing to do.
**1. Why was it changed in the first place?**  
The reason that was given for this change was that it matches the Quick Menu Links order more. I don't really think this makes a lot of sense? There is still the Profile Tab between the Notification and World Tab. Even then I don't really see how this is important, the Quick and Main Menu are vastly different from each other in terms of their Tab order and what each of these Tabs do, so it doesn't make a lot of sense to move the Social Tab more to the right so it matches more with the Quick Menu. Also, the only thing I can see how this matches the Quick Menu Links more is that when Opening the Here Tab in the Main Menu the Worlds Tab is more to the left than before.
**2. The ordering of Tabs made more sense before, (see Attachments below)**  
 Before the Tabs were split in 3 simple sections, Social Interactions (Launch Pad with your recently played with Friends etc, your Notifications about invites, friend requests etc, your own Profile and then the Social Tab) after that you had the Tabs about Content (Worlds and Avatars) and than you had all the Settings and Info Tabs (e.g. Safety Settings, Settings, etc). Now with this change this order was broken, you first have Tabs related to Social stuff (Launch Pad, Notifications, Profile) then Content related Tabs (Worlds & Avatars) and then the Social Tab.
# Suggestion:
Move the Social Tab back to the right of the Profile Tab. The first sections were all mostly focused on Social Interactions so it makes sense to put them together, especially the Profile and Social Tab.
# Attachments:
In the first picture you can see the current Layout and in the second picture the layout it had before:
